variants.user_notes: Programming through the USB bootloader needs the board in its bootloader (DFU) mode; on many boards, hold its button while plugging it in.

ai_hints: Its pins are the FPGA's RGB LED driver outputs (RGB0 to RGB2), which only sink current.
Drive them through SB_RGBA_DRV at a low current, each pin from its RGBn output.
Through the driver, a PWM input of 1 turns an LED on (low is the pin's level).
